messages.subject: Project Redwood — board approval
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, James,

Board approved this morning. We're cleared to proceed at £21.75m through the SPV (to be named Calderfield Redwood Propco Limited). Funding from equity, senior debt to follow at SPV level after completion. Please push for exchange around 24 April.

Minutes being finalised — I'll send them over for the file.

Tom
